name: Transformational Theories of Language
description: The course familiarizes students to essentials of formalism and the axiomatic-deductive method, whilst comparing it with logicism and intuitionism. Against this backdrop, the course introduces students to the Transformational Generative approach to language and mind and traces its development from the 1950s to the 1980s.
